sobre_mi.title: About me
sobre_mi.subtitle: Computer Engineer based in Santiago, Chile. Open to remote projects (UTC-3/-4).

bio.paragraph1: I'm Sebastián Rozas, a Computer Engineer with 12+ years of experience leading data process optimization and automation in demanding industries like banking, retail and logistics. My specialty is turning raw data into business value.
bio.paragraph2: I design and operate Data Warehouse solutions (Teradata, SQL Server, Sybase) and build ELT pipelines with SQL and Unix Shell. A concrete example: I re-designed a critical ETL for a banking entity, cutting execution time from 17 hours to under 90 minutes. Over my career I've also led projects for Correos de Chile (international invoicing system) and provided technical advisory to Banco BCI teams on database architecture and optimization.
bio.paragraph3: I'm currently focused on the future of software development: I apply Spec-Driven Development to drive the full project lifecycle with AI tooling. My role is to guide the AI into building robust, efficient and high-quality solutions. If you'd like to talk about data, AI applied to development, or new challenges, let's chat.

skills.title: Skills
hard: Large-scale data processing (tens of millions of records)
skills.soft: Technical leadership and team mentoring. Direct work with business, risk and product stakeholders to translate constraints into technical decisions. Transition management (hiring, training successors) and clear communication as part of the craft.
